needs.POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY: a personal API key created in PostHog under Settings > Personal API keys, with the read-only scopes needed for queries, event definitions, persons, recordings, insights, and web analytics, scoped to one project
needs.POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID: the numeric identifier of the PostHog project to read, shown under Settings > Project, and in the app URL after /project/
